title: [Dev-E] NSV3 is getting a queue and TBR aren't updated
body:
AAPS / AAPSClient 3.3.0-dev-e
Build: cab69e7cae-2024.11.30
Nightscout version: 15.0.2
Engineering mode enabled 

TBR on AAPS seem to be unable to upload to NS thus making a queue. Carbs/boluses/notes/etc seem to be working fine. If I change to NSV1 all get uploaded and synced. Then problem starts again after switching to NSV3.

See logs.
